uiTestAgent.autoInstallPrompts.description: Automatically copy the UI Test agent and prompt files into your VS Code prompts folder on activation. Existing files with local edits are preserved.

uiTestAgent.enableChromeDevToolsMcp.description: Enable the built-in browser engine that lets the agent drive a real browser. Disable only if you want to use a custom or external setup.

uiTestAgent.chromeDevToolsMcpVersion.description: Version of the bundled browser engine to use. Leave at 'latest' unless you need to pin a specific build.

uiTestAgent.chromeExecutablePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a Chrome / Chromium / Edge browser executable. When set, the agent will use this browser instead of auto-detecting one. Leave empty for automatic detection.

uiTestAgent.chromeChannel.markdownDescription: Chrome release channel to use when driving the browser. Ignored when `#uiTestAgent.chromeExecutablePath#` is set.
